game.name: Ncaa Football 07 (USA)
game.desc: The NCAA Football series allows you to experience this prestigious American football championship in a simulation by EA Games. Play as one of the official teams and compete against teams from every campus in the US. This Xbox 360 episode introduces a "Campus Legend" mode, as well as a new bonus called "Turn the Tide". The latter allows you to "boost" your players and your team momentarily when its gauge is full.
